statBlock.name: Dragon Turtle
statBlock.description: Dragon turtles patrol stretches of sea, claim passing cargo and guard submerged hoards. Some guide sailors or trade stories for a share of the treasure.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks. The dragon can substitute one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater grants no Resistance to this Fire damage.
Tail. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage and knocks a Huge or smaller creature Prone.
Steam Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. It takes 56 (16d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Being underwater grants no Resistance to this Fire damage.

statBlock.name: Young Brass Dragon
statBlock.description: Young brass dragons roam for years between visits to their lairs. Some carry news between metallic dragons.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Sleep Breath for two attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 38 (11d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure leaves it Unconscious for 1 minute. Damage wakes it, and a creature within 5 ft. can also wake it by taking an action.

statBlock.name: Young Bronze Dragon
statBlock.description: A young bronze dragon often takes up a local cause, such as protecting a port from raiders. It seeks friends who bring skills it lacks.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Repulsion Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 49 (9d10) Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Repulsion Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it is pushed up to 40 ft. directly away from the dragon and falls Prone.

statBlock.name: Young Copper Dragon
statBlock.description: Young copper dragons make close friends and move quickly from one artistic pursuit to the next.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Slowing Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 40 (9d8) Acid damage on a failure or half on a success.
Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure its Speed is halved and it cannot take Reactions. On its turn it can take an action or a Bonus Action, with a limit of one of the two. The effect lasts until the end of that creature's next turn.

statBlock.name: Young Gold Dragon
statBlock.description: Young gold dragons confront evils they have seen firsthand and often prefer direct action.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Weakening Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. It takes 55 (10d10) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone that is free of this breath's effects makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 3 (1d6) from its damage rolls. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect, and it succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

statBlock.name: Young Red Dragon
statBlock.description: Young red dragons raid for treasure and seize land where they can demand obedience.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. It takes 56 (16d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

statBlock.name: Young Silver Dragon
statBlock.description: Young silver dragons seek out heroes and older metallic dragons. They often carry messages or speak for those allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Paralyzing Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Constitution save. It takes 49 (11d8) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it saves again. A second failure leaves it Paralyzed. A Paralyzed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect, and it succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

statBlock.name: Young White Dragon
statBlock.speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
statBlock.description: Young white dragons defend their hunting grounds. Nearby communities may leave food and treasure to keep them from hunting closer to home.

sections.Traits: Ice Walk. The dragon can cross or climb ice without an ability check. Ice and snow that count as Difficult Terrain cost it no extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. It takes 40 (9d8) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
